acquisition_method.evidence: Data-independent acquisition (DIA) was carried out on the Orbitrap Exploris 480 Mass Spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, USA).

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Search criteria included carbamidomethylation of cysteine as a fixed modification

cleavage_agent.evidence: Protein extraction was conducted using s-trap purification and trypsin digestion protocols.

ionization_type.evidence: The settings of nano electrospray voltages, ion funnel RF, and capillary temperature were 1.9 kV, 50 %, 275 °C, respectively.

labeling.evidence: MaxLFQ of the intensity at MS/MS level was enabled for label free quantification and no imputation was enabled.

ptm.evidence: Search criteria included carbamidomethylation of cysteine as a fixed modification
as well as oxidation of methionine and acetylation (protein N-terminus) as variable modifications
